csv_project_name: Engrg Scv for Irving Park Rd Pedestrian Bridge Phase III
csv_scope_of_work: The Village of Roselle ( Village ) hereby invites Statements of Qualifications from IDOT prequalified engineering firms to assist the Village in completing Phase III Engineering Services for Irving Park Road Pedestrian Bridge and Main Street Multi-Use Path. Phase III Engineering Services for the project are funded through the Illinois Transportation Enhancement Program (ITEP); therefore, all work must be done in accordance with ITEP guidelines. The project includes Phase III Engineering for the construction of a shared use path from downtown Roselle to the south side of the Roselle Metra Station, including a pedestrian bridge over Irving Park Road (IL Rt 19). The scope of improvements includes various bicycle/pedestrian facilities on the south side of the Metra tracks from Park Street to the south side of the Roselle Metra Station. This includes on-street shared lanes on Main Street from Park Street to Spring Street and an off-street path from Spring Street to the south side of the Roselle Metra Station including a pedestrian bridge over Irving Park Road (IL Rt 19),
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Materials Testing, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
